limitations: This manifest publishes existing revision-1 behavior and does not define new graph or cryptographic semantics.
Graph consistency and closed declared-parent resolution do not establish historical completeness; successful cases require history_completeness = not_established.
The opt-in 64 MiB aggregate event-byte suite is separate and was not executed for this ordinary conformance pack.
Passing these cases does not establish identity, authorization, trusted time, semantic truth, complete profile conformance, certification, or security assurance.

separate_resource_suites.limitation: The index commits generation parameters and ordered-input digests but does not contain the generated event bytes; an unrestricted full resource-boundary claim requires a separate successful run or equivalent evidence.
